_comment: Page weight budget of oblivios.dev, set before the build (W-5, spec 5.5 item 6); the HTML and first-load numbers were raised on 2026-11-20 (ADR-279). Raw bytes, no compression. Checked by scripts/check-build.mjs; the build fails when one is exceeded. The search index is not part of a first load: the script fetches it when a search starts.
